title: eludite.project.item_properties input
description: A file's File Properties, as the Properties window (F4) shows them (brief 0081): Build Action (the MSBuild item type), Copy to Output Directory, Custom Tool and Custom Tool Namespace, with the Build Action choices.

path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to the solution folder.

project.description: The project listing the file, by name or path. Default: the first project of the solution that lists it.
